# Cora Platform — Comprehensive Technical & Architectural Specification
> Legal Entity: Claraverse Inc.
> Official Website: https://heycora.in
> App Workspace Portal: https://app.heycora.in/workspace
> Founder: Dravya Bansal (dravya.bansal@heycora.in)

## 1. Executive Summary
Cora is an omnichannel AI operating system and command center built specifically for solo founders, high-velocity digital agencies, photography studios, and real estate professionals. Cora eliminates tool fragmentation by orchestrating multi-model AI agent routing, automated lead-capture pipelines, legally binding e-signature document vaults, and GST-compliant tax calculations in a single high-performance workspace.

## 2. Core Architectural Pillars

### 2.1 Multi-Model AI Routing & Execution Engine
- Supported Frontier Models: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini 2.0 Flash, Groq/Llama 3.
- Persona-Specific Copilots: Pre-configured prompt chains for listing copywriting, client proposal drafting, SEO metadata generation, and contract risk audits.
- Unified Token Quotas: Single monthly quota allocated across all AI providers with zero per-model API keys required from the user.

### 2.2 Client Pipeline & Omnichannel Funnels
- Native WhatsApp Cloud API integration for instant call-sheet and shoot booking dispatch.
- Two-way Gmail & Google Workspace calendar sync.
- Drag-and-drop Kanban pipeline with automated stage triggers and payment reminders.

### 2.3 Document Vault & Digital Signatures
- 100% legally compliant digital signatures with cryptographic audit trails and IP timestamps.
- Native PDF rendering with custom brand watermarking.
- Integrated Indian GST Calculation Engine with auto-generated B2B tax invoices (CGST + SGST or IGST).

## 3. Commercial Pricing & Global Billing

### Free Forever Plan ($0 / forever)
- 1,000 AI Agent Runs per month
- Core AI Models (Google Gemini & OpenAI GPT-4o mini)
- Document Vault & E-Signatures (up to 5 active docs)
- Unlimited client funnels & bookings
- No credit card required

### India Only Annual Plan (₹4,999 / year — equivalent to ₹499 / mo)
- 2,500 AI Agent Runs per month
- All Pro Platform Features
- Direct Indian Payment Rails (UPI: GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, CRED, RuPay, NetBanking)
- Full B2B GST Invoicing with GSTIN validation

### Starter Plan ($9 / mo billed monthly or $90 / year)
- 5,000 AI Agent Runs per month
- Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet access
- Custom workspace domain
- Full document vault capacity

### Pro Studio Plan ($19 / mo billed monthly or $190 / year)
- 10,000 AI Agent Runs per month
- All Frontier AI Models (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.0 Flash)
- 3 Multi-User Team Seats
- B2B GST-compliant invoicing & priority support

### Scale & Agency Plan ($39 / mo billed monthly or $390 / year)
- Unlimited AI Agent executions
- 10 Team Seats with granular RBAC permissions
- Custom fine-tuned AI personas & 99.9% uptime SLA

## 4. Free Public Web Micro-Tools
- **Indian GST Calculator & Invoice Generator**: https://heycora.in/tools/gst-calculator

## 5. Security, Privacy & Compliance
- Transport Security: Strict HTTPS / TLS 1.3 with HSTS.
- Data Privacy: Zero client training on proprietary business data.
- Payment Processing: PCI-DSS Level 1 certified via Razorpay & Stripe.
